description: This Java class LogWrapper wraps the Android Log utility to route log messages through a chain of LogNode objects, allowing for flexible and extendable logging output.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode to wrap Android's native Log utility and support chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority and tag, optionally including an exception trace, then forwards the log to the next node if present.
